nyang gter rgyal mdos dkar po drug mdos kyi 'don zin yin/dbang drag pad+mar gus pas 'dud/mnga' bdag sku sprul nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyis bsam yas byang cha

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250nyang gter rgyal mdos dkar po drug mdos kyi 'don zin yin/1$0000300 dbang drag pad+mar gus pas 'dud/

mnga' bdag sku sprul nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyis bsam yas byang chub chen po'i sku rgyab kyi gter byon/ rgyal po dkar po drug mdos kyi mdos chings rin chen phreng ba'i 'don zin ni/ ngag 'don khrigs bsdebs ltar bstod las kyi rdzas rnams sngags drug phyag drug dang*/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ zhes dpa' bo 'bru lnga'i sngags rnams lan gsum re brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ drug mdos kyi mdun bskyed las/ oṃ swā bhā wa sa sbyang*/ mdos thams cad mi dmigs pa sogs nas/ mtshan par gyur/ rang nyid skad cig gis 1$0000230 gong non yi dam rta mgrin la sbyar skabs gzhung ltar yin yang*/ gzhan du na/mchan/ 1$0000300dpal chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ mdun gyi dpal chen po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig la sogs nas/ gtsug lag chen po nas chos skyong rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs shing*/ mdun gyi rten dang gnyis med du bzhugs par gyur/ 'og gi stod kyi las 'phyong ltar/ kyai: sngags 'chang rgyal po bdag cag gis: sogs nas/ rnga gshang skad kyis 'bod: bar gyis snyan gsan dbab/ gong gi mdun bskyed 'phros gzhung ltar/ kyai: sngon tshe dgung sngon sogs kyis spyan drangs/ 'og gi stod 'phyong ltar/ kyai: de ring srid pa'i mdos gtong la: sogs rnga rabs dang*/ srid pa'i khog phub gyer/ glud la phyag yug ma bsnyab cig: bar/ 'og nas/ srung ma bskul ba/ dbang sdud/ zil gnon rnams bya/ 'og nas/ kyai: srid pa'i mdos kyi gzhi gang 'dir: sogs nas/ 'di ru ma 'grims shig: bar gyis mi dbang bkar/ de'i gong gi / kyai: sangs rgyas rkang gnyis sogs bden brjod/ yas bzhes 'tshal: bar/ 'og gi khrus gsol/ spos rabs/ gong nas/ kyai: de ring skyems 'di sogs gser skyems 'bul/ thams cad gnang bar mdzod: bar/ 'og nas/ kyai: gto yas bsags pa gang nas sogs kyis byung khung btsal zhing*/

yon tan brjod/ gong nas/ kyai: de ring srid pa'i mdos gtong ngo: sogs nas thun dbab pa rnams dang*/ mdos gzhung dngos te bar 'phyong la/ kyai: phyogs phyogs de ni pha ki na: sogs kyis yas stags/ phyin chad 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig: bar gyer zhing*/ smad kyi las 'phyong mjug gi sku glud la/ sam+bha ra dang*/ mtshan bzhi brjod de/ kyai: bdag dang rgyu 'byor yon bdag gis: sogs mthar chags su gyer/ smad kyi las 'phyong gi dkyus las/ kyai: snang zhing srid pa'i sogs mdos gtang ba/ kha bsgyur/ dbang bskur/ rdzongs 'debs/ g.yang len/ bka' bsgo/ khal 'gel/ khram kha bsgyur ba rnams dang*/ gong gi gzhung bar 'phyong las/ kyai: rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas: sogs bka' bsgo ba/ 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig: bar/ 'og gi smad 'phyong gi mjug las/ kyai: snang srid lha 'dre gnyan po rnams: sogs sgo dbye/ gshegs yul btsal ba/ lam bstan/ zhig sa'am mi rtag ston pa/ grub gnas/ skos 'debs rnams dang*/ gong gi gzhung bar 'phyong mjug gi / kyai: da ni rgyal po bzhud re ran: sogs gshegs zhus dang rdzongs 'debs bcas mdos bskyal lo// sher snying dgu zlog bya/ srung 'khor bsgom zhing*/ shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan no// zhes pa 'di'ang nyer mkho'i slad du grong sngags mkhan po mkha' khyab rdo rjer 'bod pas 'du bgyis pa'o// maṅga laṃ/// / 1$0000230 ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
